biotools.summary: CREDO is a tool that simplifies the creation of reproducible Docker containers for bioinformatics applications, addressing challenges related to inconsistencies and lack of standardization in bioinformatics pipelines. It generates Dockerfiles incorporating heterogeneous packages, facilitating easy image creation and promoting open science practices.
